purpose: Synthetic call templates for the companion workflow and its contract tests. Replace the example content with verified task evidence. Do not ingest these demonstration facts into production.

placeholders.$AGENT_ID: Stable contribution identity of the actual writer; different agents use their own identities.
placeholders.$SCOPE: One agreed project scope; omit scope entirely for generalCalls. Project tests use a fresh disposable namespace.
placeholders.$QUERY: Focused search terms for the current task; general-memory tests use a unique synthetic subject in a disposable database.
placeholders.$FACT_TEXT: One verified general-memory fact including its actual conditions; use a synthetic fact only in a disposable test database.
placeholders.$CORRECTION_TEXT: A verified replacement fact for the unscoped target; the directive text must match decomposition exactly.
placeholders.$SESSION_ID: The actual stable session ID; do not invent sessions to manufacture feedback.
placeholders.$REQUEST_ID: A UUID generated once per logical write and retained with its exact arguments for retries.
placeholders.$FRAGMENT_ID: The verified target ID returned by search or a successful write, never guessed. A general correction requires an unscoped target.
